# Shaamy Lounge Unisex Salon and Academy, Davangere: full facts

Last updated: 2026-11-19. Site: https://udaylal2k.github.io/shammy-site/

## Who and where
- Shaamy Lounge Unisex Salon, Davangere, Karnataka, India. Founded 2015. One of the first unisex salons in Davangere.
- Founder: Roopa G.R., hair stylist, colourist, skin consultant and makeup artist, and a hair, skin and makeup trainer with international certification. 22 years of experience.
- Training: L'Oréal Hair Academy (diploma), City & Guilds Level 1, TONI&GUY Singapore (Creative Colour and Classic Cutting), Pivot Point, Kryolan (makeup, basic to masters), Thalion (product training, France). She began as a trainer for L'Oréal's MATRIX division in Chennai and was Managing Partner at WOW Boutique Salon & Spa from 2010 to 2013.
- Address: 4th Main Road, 3rd Cross, Above Biba Clothing Store, MCC B Block, Davangere 577004, Karnataka.
- Hours: open daily, 9:00 AM to 9:30 PM.
- Phone and WhatsApp: +91 9538316195, +91 9620716325. Email: roopargujjar@gmail.com
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/shaamy_lounge/ . Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/shamyslounge
- Area served: Davangere, with services reaching Harihar, Ranebennur and Chitradurga.
- Prices are shared when you book; none are published on the site.

## Services
- Hair: haircuts and styling, colour and texture, keratin and smoothening, head massage, hair spa. https://udaylal2k.github.io/shammy-site/hair-colour-keratin-davangere.html
- Skin: clean-ups, facials, advanced and HydraFacials, bridal facials, body massage, de-tan. https://udaylal2k.github.io/shammy-site/facials-skin-treatments-davangere.html
- Bridal and occasion makeup: trial MAC, trial hair do, complete Kryolan, MAC, HD and airbrush makeup, bridesmaid makeup, saree draping. https://udaylal2k.github.io/shammy-site/bridal-makeup-davangere.html
- Men's grooming: cuts, shaving and beard work, colouring, hair spa, skin care. https://udaylal2k.github.io/shammy-site/mens-grooming-davangere.html
- Waxing, manicure and pedicure. Full women's and men's menu: https://udaylal2k.github.io/shammy-site/menu.html
- Brands used include L'Oréal Professionnel, Schwarzkopf, Wella Professionals, Moroccanoil, MAC, Kryolan, Kanpeki Japan, Janssen Germany, O3+ and HydraFacial.

## Academy
- Shaamy Lounge Academy offers a 3-month professional certification in hair (month 1), skin (month 2) and makeup (month 3), followed by a live internship in a working salon. Graduates receive a Shaamy Lounge Academy certificate. Fees, batch dates and joining details are shared on enquiry. https://udaylal2k.github.io/shammy-site/academy.html
- Roopa also trains salon teams on site (techniques, grooming workshops, salon management support).

## Bridal questions
- Is there a bridal trial? Yes: trial MAC makeup and trial hair do can be booked before the wedding.
- Which bridal makeup options? Complete Kryolan, MAC, HD and airbrush makeup; party and advanced party makeup; saree draping; Toppik hair filler.
- Bridesmaid makeup? Yes: regular, Kryolan, MAC, and MAC with concealing and contouring.
- Facials before the wedding? Save the Date Bridal Facial, O3 Bridal Facial, Janssen Bridal Whitening Facial.
- Cost? Shared on booking via WhatsApp.
